exposure: Progesterone therapy (16 mg/kg daily s.c. injections)
cohort: Preterm guinea pig neonates delivered at 62 days of gestation by caesarean section, along with term-delivered controls.
finding: Progesterone treatment increased brain allopregnanolone concentrations and plasma progesterone/cortisol in males, but decreased cerebellar myelination markers (MBP, PLP, OLIG2, PDGFRalpha) in male neonates compared with term animals.
